milestone_name: Live-Machine Pilot (SFC + Master Post Parallel Tracks)
scope: Progressive-trust live-machine validation of SFC and Master Post on JM Die's 21-machine fleet, sequenced lowest-risk to flagship

calendar.critical_path_reason: Force-calibration requires real cutting data not available before P3

first_target_machine.rationale: Toolroom mill, $35K, low utilization, MTConnect-equipped, oddball-jobs duty cycle, lowest collateral on first-touch defect

sfc_phases.name: bench-sim
sfc_phases.failure_rollback: Block ship; /forge-perf kc1.1 recalibration; add to PENDING_GAP_ENGINES.json

sfc_phases.name: cut-air
sfc_phases.acceptance: Motion within 0.001in; zero alarms; spindle <5%; operator R/Y/G=green
sfc_phases.failure_rollback: Halt; diff NC; SFC vs MP isolation; per-controller block

sfc_phases.name: soft-stock
sfc_phases.acceptance: Force +/-20% prediction; Ra within 1.5x; zero breakage 10 parts/material
sfc_phases.failure_rollback: Lock material 'shadow-only'; /lathe-learn or /mill-learn calibration; block P4 graduation

sfc_phases.name: production-shadow
sfc_phases.acceptance: >=100 ops; delta <25% RPM <30% feed; shadow read-only
sfc_phases.failure_rollback: Tighten model with shop delta; /shop-knowledge ingestion; no machine impact

sfc_phases.name: A-B
sfc_phases.acceptance: Tool life >=95% status-quo; cycle <=105%; Cpk >= status-quo; zero PRISM scrap

sfc_phases.name: primary
sfc_phases.acceptance: PRISM default >=80% new jobs; override <15%; tool life +>=5% vs P5; zero collision events
sfc_phases.failure_rollback: Per-material drop to P4 shadow; red-button single-press fallback

sfc_phases.name: telemetry-loop
sfc_phases.failure_rollback: Versioned model rollback model_v_N-1; manual freeze; weekly human-in-loop PR review

masterpost_phases.name: bench-sim
masterpost_phases.acceptance: 100% byte-equivalence vs JM Die golden NC archive (comments-only delta allowed)
masterpost_phases.failure_rollback: Per-controller block; fix MasterPostEngine + regression test

masterpost_phases.name: cut-air
masterpost_phases.acceptance: Zero alarms; modal display matches expected; tool-change correct
masterpost_phases.failure_rollback: Halt; diff vs archived program; patch post + re-bench

masterpost_phases.name: soft-stock
masterpost_phases.acceptance: Cut motion identical to operator-written; no unexpected dwells; spindle ramps correctly

masterpost_phases.name: production-shadow
masterpost_phases.acceptance: PRISM-post vs operator-post semantically equivalent (motion identical, stylistic-only delta)
masterpost_phases.failure_rollback: Per-controller style-template adjustment; no machine impact

masterpost_phases.name: A-B
masterpost_phases.acceptance: Cycle-time delta <2%; zero alarms attributable to PRISM-post; readability >=4/5

masterpost_phases.name: primary
masterpost_phases.acceptance: PRISM-post default; zero collision events; multi-axis kinematic verified against Mazak SmoothAi simulator pre-cut (every program)

masterpost_phases.name: telemetry-loop
masterpost_phases.acceptance: Post-edit operator-touched-lines trends to zero; style template auto-tunes per controller

top_risk.description: Flagship multi-axis kinematic miscompile at P6 on Mazak-Integrex-i200-2021 ($450K)
top_risk.consequence: Turret-into-billet collision at rapid; single-event terminates pilot credibility
mitigations: Mandatory Mazak SmoothAi sim pre-cut (every flagship program)
Operator red-button physical single-press fallback to status-quo post
Collision-check hook hard-gate via forge-safety chain (zero-exception block)
Holo-Krome / SFS aerospace families enter P6 only after dedicated P5 A-B on those parts

critical_instrumentation.purpose: PRISM-emit vs Vericut sim delta (force, motion, cycle)
Byte-diff vs JM Die golden NC archive across 6 controllers

machines: all P2+ machines, Haas-TM-1P, Mazak-QT-200, Haas-VF-2, Doosan, Mazak-Integrex

critical_instrumentation.purpose: Free-text + tagged-code drop-down for override reasons
Tool life, cycle time, Cpk per A-B cohort

operator_artifacts: PRISM-Override-Reasons-Cheatsheet.md (drop-down codes for P4 shadow-mode capture)
Phase-3 wax-cut training video (10 min, machine-by-machine)
Phase-4 dual-log dashboard tutorial (operator-facing UI, /shop-floor-query integration)
Phase-5 A-B job-card insert (visual: which jobs are PRISM vs status-quo)
Phase-6 escalation tree (operator -> shop-lead -> programmer -> PRISM-engineer -> red-button, <5min each)
Master-Post per-controller code-style reference cards (Haas NGC, Fanuc 31i, Mazatrol Smooth G, OSP-P300, Siemens 840D sl, Anilam)
Red-button physical single-press fallback (installed on P6 flagship machines pre-entry)

units.title: SFCRecommendationLogger + VericutDiffEngine + ForceBudgetGate (P1 SFC ship gate)
MasterPostByteEquivalenceCI + JM Die golden NC archive snapshot across 6 controllers (P1 MP ship gate)
MTConnect spindle-load streamer + adapter for P2+ machines

Phase-4 production-shadow rollout on Haas-VF-2 + Mazak-QT-200 + Doosan-DNM-4500
Flagship pre-flight: Mazak SmoothAi sim gate + cam-toolpath-check hard-block + red-button physical install (P6 entry)
Phase-6 primary rollout on Mazak-Integrex + DMG-Mori-NTX + Makino-PS95
/forge-learn weekly recalibration cron + auto-PR for kc1.1 / Taylor constants
Operator training package: 8 artifacts (runbook, cheatsheet, video, tutorial, job-card, escalation tree, controller cards, red-button install guide)

risk_register.description: Flagship Mazak-Integrex P6 multi-axis kinematic miscompile -> collision
risk_register.mitigation: Mandatory SmoothAi sim pre-cut + red-button + collision-check hook hard-gate + dedicated Holo-Krome/SFS P5 A-B before P6 entry

risk_register.description: Spindle overload on P3 wax cut due to wrong Kienzle for novel alloy
risk_register.mitigation: ForceBudgetGate hard-blocks >70% spindle torque; P1 force-budget gate must pass first

risk_register.description: Operator rejection as 'CAM-textbook' kills adoption pre-A-B
risk_register.mitigation: P4 shadow captures override reasons (tagged); tribal-tip ingestion before P5; operator co-design of P5 acceptance

risk_register.description: Tool-life regression silent until weeks into P5
Post-processor regression breaks legacy archived programs
risk_register.mitigation: P1 byte-equivalence gate on all 6 controllers + CI gate

risk_register.description: Legacy Bridgeport/Anilam DNC pass-through breaks long programs (no MTConnect)
risk_register.mitigation: Limit legacy to P2/P3 short programs; DNC log capture + manual operator log

risk_register.description: Holo-Krome high-tolerance P6 jobs fail Cpk
risk_register.mitigation: Holo-Krome family enters P6 only after dedicated P5 A-B exclusively on those jobs; Cpk real-time monitored

risk_register.description: Telemetry-loop poisoning by sensor failure / outlier
risk_register.mitigation: DriftDetector outlier-rejection + model-version rollback; weekly human-in-loop PR review

risk_register.description: Wage-of-shop-time burned on P2/P3 if defects > 1 per phase
risk_register.mitigation: P1 100% acceptance before P2 starts; cut-air budget 4 hrs/machine; soft-stock budget 16 hrs/material

risk_register.description: Calendar slip from shop-conservatism extends each phase
risk_register.mitigation: Pre-negotiate phase budgets with shop lead; 25% schedule buffer baked in; 'soft graduation' at 90%+ acceptance with shop confidence hold

sfc.P1: ForceBudgetGate Fc<0.7*spindle_torque + Vericut diff + >=95% catalog match +/-15%
sfc.P3: +/-20% force prediction on instrumented wax cuts
sfc.P5: Tool life >=95% status-quo + cycle <=105% + Cpk >= status-quo + zero scrap
sfc.P6: Override rate <15% + PRISM default >=80% new jobs + tool life +>=5% vs P5 + zero collision

masterpost.P1: Byte-equivalence vs JM Die golden NC archive (comments-only delta)
masterpost.P6: Flagship multi-axis verified against Mazak SmoothAi simulator (every program, no exceptions)
